item.description: The _expand_targets method in NotifyNextcloud has incomplete logic for handling empty or whitespace-only targets. The method does not properly validate targets before attempting to process them, leading to incorrect behavior when processing targets like 'all' or group targets.
item.contract: Fix the _expand_targets method to properly validate and process all target types including 'all', group targets (starting with #), and direct user targets. Ensure that empty or whitespace-only targets are properly filtered out and that all target types are correctly expanded.

item.description: The send method in NotifyNextcloud does not properly handle the case when no targets are provided. The method should return False when there are no valid targets to notify, but the current implementation may proceed with processing.
item.contract: Ensure the send method properly validates that there are valid targets to notify. If no valid targets exist, the method should return False immediately without proceeding with any further processing.

item.description: The _get_all_users method in NotifyNextcloud has incorrect error handling. When the API call fails to return valid JSON, the method returns None instead of properly handling the error case.
item.contract: Update the _get_all_users method to properly handle cases where the API response is invalid or contains unexpected JSON structure. The method should return an empty list or handle the error gracefully instead of returning None.

item.description: The details() method in NotifyNextcloud is not properly implemented or accessible. The API test expects this method to return plugin details, but it appears to be missing or incomplete.
item.contract: Ensure the details() method in NotifyNextcloud returns a proper dictionary with plugin details including service_name, service_url, setup_url, templates, template_tokens, template_args, and template_kwargs.

item.description: The url_identifier property in NotifyNextcloud has incomplete implementation. It's not properly generating unique identifiers for URL comparison purposes.
item.contract: Complete the url_identifier property implementation to return a tuple containing all identifiers that make a URL unique from another similar one, excluding targets or endpoints.
